items.content_text: Retired outfielder Sam Fuld was the Philadelphia Phillies’ general manager when he received a surprising offer: get an M.B.A. and come back as the club’s president of business operations.

items.title: Homeowners are suing builders over mold they say is making them sick, seeking millions of dollars in damages. Builders say their fears are overblown.
items.content_text: Homeowner lawsuits against home builders allege mold-related illnesses, while builders say the allegations are off the mark and costing them millions.

items.title: FDA Approves Alzheimer’s Blood Test Developed by Roche and Eli Lilly
items.content_text: The Food and Drug Administration cleared a blood test for identifying Alzheimer’s disease symptoms, which was developed by Roche and Eli Lilly.

items.title: Antonio Banderas’s Heart Attack Fueled His Acting
items.content_text: The actor learned to shuck oysters and clean fish to play a mentor to a teenage Anthony Bourdain in the new movie “Tony.”

items.title: Eli Lilly Launches Foundayo Weight-Loss Pill in U.K.
items.content_text: The once-daily pill was approved for patients with a body mass index of at least 30, or between 27 and 30 in the event of at least one weight-related health condition.

items.title: English Soccer’s Richest Club Begins Its Great Succession Experiment
items.content_text: With Pep Guardiola gone, Manchester City kicked off its first Premier League campaign under his successor. It very nearly went wrong.

items.title: 147 Laps Around the Mall: Washington Hosts Freedom 250 Street Race
items.content_text: President Trump waved the green start flag to kick off the 250-mile race in Washington, D.C., the longest street course in IndyCar history.

items.title: If You Haven’t Seen ‘The Spectacle,’ You’re Missing the WNBA’s Top Rookie
items.content_text: Minnesota Lynx guard Olivia Miles is in the mix to join Candace Parker as the league’s second dual Rookie of the Year-MVP.

items.title: Baby boomers are big pot users. And it’s causing big problems.
items.content_text: Cannabis critics feel trapped, with even some doctors and police siding with their pot-using peers. It’s leading to legal threats, cop calls and arguments straight out of high school.

items.title: Heard on the Street: Moderna’s mRNA cancer vaccine marks a major leap in personalized oncology. But the financial math is sobering.
items.content_text: Personalized mRNA shots may prove neither as wide-reaching nor as lucrative as hoped.

items.title: Mental-health professionals are supposed to keep their personal experiences, values and opinions out of the therapy room. Yet more appear to be falling short, experts say.
items.content_text: More mental-health professionals appear to be espousing their own ideology or adopting cultural trends, such as encouraging victimhood and estrangement.

items.title: After its COVID success, Moderna endured years of falling vaccine sales, a plummeting stock price and attacks on its science. Now, its melanoma vaccine data notched a much-needed win for the company.
items.content_text: After years of layoffs, cash burn and political attacks on its core technology, Moderna’s melanoma vaccine data notched the biotech company a much-needed win.

items.title: An outbreak of E. coli and salmonella linked to alfalfa sprouts has sickened dozens of people across 15 states
items.content_text: More than 50 people have been infected in connection with the outbreak, public- health officials said.
